AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Improved Accuracy for Automated Counting of a Fish in Baited Underwater Videos for Stock Assessment
REGION: Bernier Island, Shark Bay, Gascoyne region, Western Australia
SPECIES: Chrysophrys auratus (target); Lutjanus vitta and Lutjanus carponotatus annotated as confusion classes
DATA: Own BRUVS footage, six sites, July 2019; 4,690 train/val annotations + 3,627 test annotations (+271 for two confusion species)
V_EV: Dataset and Deep Learning Model: 'Sites comprised mixed rock-sand habitats in 30–60 m water depth'
D2: Train/val from Sites 1, 3, 5 (80/20 of 4,690 annotations); test from Sites 2, 4, 6 (3,627 annotations)
D_EV: Methods: 'We created a dataset for training and validation from videos at three sites (Sites 1, 3, and 5), and an independent dataset for testing from videos at the other three sites'
R_EV: Discussion: 'At this stage, the optimal procedure is addressed only for snapper at the multiple sites within the survey area in the Gascoyne region'
C_EV: Methods: 'We tried CTs from 0 to 95% in 5% increments. Seq-NMS is a spatio-temporal filter that creates detection chains'
E_EV: Results: 'A comparison of automated counts from the final revised modelling procedure against manual ground-truth counts gave an R2 of 88%'; MaxN for 1 h videos compared per site
ARCH: Faster R-CNN (maskrcnn-benchmark) with ResNet50 backbone + Seq-NMS post-processing + cubic polynomial count correction
METR: R2 of predicted vs manual counts (120 CT/Seq-NMS/equation combinations); MaxN and mean MaxN per 30 s over first 5 min; whole-video MaxN per site
NOTE: Test data are held-out sites (2, 4, 6) from the same July 2019 survey, same gear and region; coded as a site-level split (D_ALL = Y) but NOT as an external test (R1 = N) because the paper itself restricts validity to the survey area and anticipates domain shift elsewhere. A verifier may prefer R1 = Y / R2 = 사이트. Visibility never characterised; only depth 30–60 m reported (gives V_ALL = P mechanically). Confidence thresholds swept 0–95% in 5% steps (Supplementary Table 2) and Seq-NMS explicitly addresses double/triple detections of the same fish, hence C5 = 중복계수 처리 and C_ALL = Y. The cubic correction equation is fitted on the test sites' own ground truth (potential optimism). NIMG null: only annotation counts (not frame counts) are given; number of videos not stated. ENV: subtropical mixed rock-sand habitat at 30–60 m, coded 온대 암반/켈프 as nearest option.
